title: Qozzy British Bangers And Mash
description: A spicy and gooey hangover-cure dish with pink food coloring, lamination-puff, and anti-inflammatory-friendly bangers and mash.
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add beef mince to the pot, breaking it up with a wooden spoon. Cook until browned.
Stir in salt, pepper, and chicken stock cube. Simmer for about 20 minutes or until meat is tender.
Pour mixture into a blender, add pink food coloring (if using), blend until smooth, then pour back into pot. Mix well to combine.
Preheat oven to 160°C (320°F). Divide the bangers and mash mix evenly between 4 lamination-puff cups.
Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes or until puffs are golden brown and cheese sauce is bubbly.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
